Core services

One coordinated engineering partner.

From initial investigation through construction observation, GeoStruct connects subsurface insight, structural response and practical delivery.

01

Geotechnical

Subsurface investigations and geotechnical consultation for residential, commercial, institutional, industrial and transportation projects—plus foundations, retaining structures and slope stability.

02

Geostructures

Integrated analysis of earth, water and structure for excavation support, earth-retention systems, foundations, slope stabilization and selected ground-improvement applications.

03

Project Management

Construction specifications, on-site observation, design-intent review and practical analysis when conditions change—keeping technical decisions aligned with delivery.

Project experience

Recent project work.

Investigations, designs, inspections and independent reviews across Ontario and beyond — from below grade to rooftop.

01

North York Harvest Food Bank

Toronto, ON

Structural design and drawings for an 18 ft non-load-bearing wall and 12 ft circular bulkhead — interior warehouse renovation issued for tender.

02

Site Service Permit for DCW Line Upgrade

Toronto, ON

Water demand and servicing calculations, Site Servicing Plan to City of Toronto standards, and full permit management through approval.

03

Garage Door Replacement / Upgrade

Toronto, ON

Site visit and structural assessment, structural design and drawings, and City of Toronto building permit support.

04

Phase I / Phase II ESA and Risk Assessment Review

Essex, ON

Independent review of environmental site assessment and screening-level risk assessment reports: contamination depth and extent, severity, and impact on future use.

05

Foundation Inspection Letter

Smiths Falls, ON

Site inspection of an existing foundation; an unbiased opinion on the condition of foundations and structure, identifying damaged components and future risk.

06

Below-Subgrade Staircase Inspection (Building Permit #24-1729 ARU)

Mississauga, ON

Site visit and field investigation verifying the below-grade basement entrance staircase to satisfy a City of Mississauga Fire & Emergency Services inspection order.

07Ongoing

Geotechnical Investigation and Laboratory Testing

St. Jacobs, ON

Six boreholes (3.0–13.0 m deep) across four lots to assess slope stability, with SPT, soil sampling and stratigraphy, Shelby tubes and vane shear in soft soils, two monitoring wells, and laboratory testing.

08

Geotechnical Investigation for 3-Storey Dwelling Upgrade

Toronto, ON

Four boreholes (7.0–12.0 m deep), SPT and soil sampling, groundwater observations, and a geotechnical report with recommendations for foundations, slab-on-grade, excavation and backfilling.

09

Structural & Geotechnical Peer Review — Tourist Resort

Lezha, Albania

Independent preliminary peer review of common infrastructure design: ground characterization, seismic and liquefaction assessment, embankment and retaining-system stability, settlement, and foundation conditions — plus structural review of a water tank and retaining walls.

10

Geotechnical Design Projects (Various)

Various locations

Ground-induced settlement analysis for microtunneling of a sewer main; shallow and deep foundation geotechnical design; P-Y curves for lateral pile analysis; slope stability analysis.
